text: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants must be foreign citizens holding a valid passport and aged between 18 and 25 (in principle). 2.Applicants who emigrated from China must provide a foreign passport issued before April 30, 2022, proof of canceled Chinese nationality, and evidence of residing abroad for at least 2 years within the past 4 years (a stay of 9 months or more in a year counts as one full year, verified by entry and exit stamps). 3.Applicants must be in good health, exhibit good conduct, and be willing to comply with the laws and regulations of China and BIFT’s disciplinary rules, while respecting Chinese customs. 4.Applicants must hold a recognized high school diploma or equivalent qualifications. 5.Chinese language proficiency must meet at least HSK Level 4.
